name: Zygote
description: Not a published list: Flashpoint Stage 21's deck for Khan: Savvy Skiptracer, on Hit List's list, so the sweeps meet a Runner who may install an icebreaker for 1[credit] less the first time each turn they pass a piece of ice. Eternal-legal only. Flashpoint Stage 22 traded First Responders for Government Investigations, so the sweeps meet a current that keeps both players from spending 2[credit] on a psi game. Stage 23 traded Officer Frank for Tracker, so the sweeps meet a run whose first subroutine to resolve does not. Stage 24 traded its Swift for Mirror, so the sweeps meet a console that puts a spent recurring credit back on Pheromones after a successful run on R&D. Mumbad Stage 19 swaps one Inside Job for Freedom Through Equality. Mumbad Stage 23 swapped a Femme Fatale for Reflection. SanSan Stage 17 Two Blackmail take Networking's place. One Special Order became a Power Tap, so the sweeps hear a trace initiated (Engine words, Stage 3). Two Copycats came in for both Fall Guys, for a run that continues from another copy of the ice just passed (Engine words Stage 9).
